# ============================================================
# CELL 1 — MCT configuration
# ============================================================

STORAGE_ACCOUNT = "navispowerbidatastorage2"
CONTAINER = "mct"

DELTA_MOVES_PATH = "silver/moves1"
OUTPUT_PATH = "gold/rehandles_report_mct"

TABLE_NAME = "rehandles_db.rehandle_details_mct"

# A shift must be strictly before the load, and no more than
# two hours before it.
THRESHOLD_SECONDS = 7200

# Preserve the event definition in the attached DGT notebook.
# Add "UNIT_YARD_MOVE" here only if DGT uses it for rehandles.
SHIFT_EVENTS = ["UNIT_YARD_SHIFT"]
LOAD_EVENT = "UNIT_LOAD"

BASE_PATH = (
    f"abfss://{CONTAINER}@{STORAGE_ACCOUNT}.dfs.core.windows.net"
)
MOVES_PATH = f"{BASE_PATH}/{DELTA_MOVES_PATH}"
OUTPUT_DELTA = f"{BASE_PATH}/{OUTPUT_PATH}"

assert THRESHOLD_SECONDS >= 0

print("Moves source :", MOVES_PATH)
print("Output target:", OUTPUT_DELTA)
print("Table name   :", TABLE_NAME)
print("Shift events :", SHIFT_EVENTS)

# ============================================================
# CELL 2 — Imports and MCT FROM-position parser
# ============================================================

from datetime import datetime

from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.sql import Window

# Standard block:  Y-MCT-169A03A  -> section=169A, bay=03, tier=A
MCT_STANDARD_PATTERN = (
    r"^Y-MCT-([0-9]{3}[A-Z])([0-9]{2})([A-Z])$"
)

# Extended block:  Y-MCT-562DR01A -> section=562DR, bay=01, tier=A
MCT_EXTENDED_PATTERN = (
    r"^Y-MCT-([0-9]{3}[A-Z]{2})([0-9]{2})([A-Z])$"
)

# Heap area:       Y-MCT-H11A     -> section=H11A
MCT_HEAP_PATTERN = (
    r"^Y-MCT-([A-Z][0-9]{2}[A-Z])$"
)


def with_mct_from_position(df):
    """
    Adds from_section, from_bay, from_tier_letter, and from_stack.

    Standard blocks:  section=169A,  bay=03,  tier=A  → stack '169A-03'
    Extended blocks:  section=562DR, bay=01,  tier=A  → stack '562DR-01-A'
    Heap areas:       section=H11A                    → stack 'H11A'
    Unrecognised:     from_stack = None (excluded from matching)

    Tier is included in the extended stack key but not the standard one.
    """
    df = df.withColumn(
        "_norm",
        F.upper(F.trim(F.col("From_Position_Name")))
    )

    is_standard = F.col("_norm").rlike(MCT_STANDARD_PATTERN)
    is_extended = F.col("_norm").rlike(MCT_EXTENDED_PATTERN)
    is_heap     = F.col("_norm").rlike(MCT_HEAP_PATTERN)

    df = (
        df
        .withColumn(
            "from_section",
            F.when(
                is_standard,
                F.regexp_extract(F.col("_norm"), MCT_STANDARD_PATTERN, 1),
            )
            .when(
                is_extended,
                F.regexp_extract(F.col("_norm"), MCT_EXTENDED_PATTERN, 1),
            )
            .when(
                is_heap,
                F.regexp_extract(F.col("_norm"), MCT_HEAP_PATTERN, 1),
            )
            .otherwise(F.lit(None).cast("string")),
        )
        .withColumn(
            "from_bay",
            F.when(
                is_standard,
                F.regexp_extract(F.col("_norm"), MCT_STANDARD_PATTERN, 2),
            )
            .when(
                is_extended,
                F.regexp_extract(F.col("_norm"), MCT_EXTENDED_PATTERN, 2),
            )
            .otherwise(F.lit(None).cast("string")),
        )
        .withColumn(
            "from_tier_letter",
            F.when(
                is_standard,
                F.regexp_extract(F.col("_norm"), MCT_STANDARD_PATTERN, 3),
            )
            .when(
                is_extended,
                F.regexp_extract(F.col("_norm"), MCT_EXTENDED_PATTERN, 3),
            )
            .otherwise(F.lit(None).cast("string")),
        )
    )

    # Stack key:
    #   Standard → section-bay            (e.g. '169A-03')
    #   Extended → section-bay-tier       (e.g. '562DR-01-A')
    #   Heap     → section only           (e.g. 'H11A')
    df = df.withColumn(
        "from_stack",
        F.when(
            is_standard,
            F.concat_ws("-", F.col("from_section"), F.col("from_bay")),
        )
        .when(
            is_extended,
            F.concat_ws(
                "-",
                F.col("from_section"),
                F.col("from_bay"),
                F.col("from_tier_letter"),
            ),
        )
        .when(
            is_heap,
            F.col("from_section"),
        )
        .otherwise(F.lit(None).cast("string")),
    )

    return df.drop("_norm")

# ============================================================
# CELL 3 — Parser tests
# ============================================================

expected_stacks = {
    "Y-MCT-169A03A":      "169A-03",     # standard
    "Y-MCT-785B06B":      "785B-06",     # standard
    "Y-MCT-562DR01A":     "562DR-01-A",  # extended
    "Y-MCT-560DR01A":     "560DR-01-A",  # extended
    "Y-MCT-H11A":         "H11A",        # heap area
    "NOT-A-MCT-POSITION": None,          # unrecognised
}

test_positions = spark.createDataFrame(
    [(pos,) for pos in expected_stacks],
    ["From_Position_Name"],
)

parsed_test = with_mct_from_position(test_positions)

actual_stacks = {
    row["From_Position_Name"]: row["from_stack"]
    for row in parsed_test.select(
        "From_Position_Name", "from_stack"
    ).collect()
}

assert actual_stacks == expected_stacks, (
    f"Parser test failed: {actual_stacks}"
)

parsed_test.select(
    "From_Position_Name",
    "from_section",
    "from_bay",
    "from_tier_letter",
    "from_stack",
).show(truncate=False)

print("MCT parser tests passed.")

# ============================================================
# CELL 4 — Read MCT moves
# ============================================================

RELEVANT_EVENTS = [LOAD_EVENT] + SHIFT_EVENTS

df_moves = (
    spark.read.format("delta")
    .load(MOVES_PATH)
    .withColumn(
        "event_type",
        F.upper(F.trim(F.col("Event_Type_Id")))
    )
    .filter(
        F.col("t_put").isNotNull()
        & F.col("event_type").isin(RELEVANT_EVENTS)
    )
)

df_moves = with_mct_from_position(df_moves)   # <-- MCT parser

print("Relevant MCT moves:", df_moves.count())

df_moves.select(
    "mve_gkey",
    "Unit_Nbr",
    "event_type",
    "From_Position_Name",
    "from_stack",
    "t_put",
).show(10, truncate=False)

# ============================================================
# CELL 5 — Prepare loads and shifts
# ============================================================

loads = (
    df_moves
    .filter(F.col("event_type") == LOAD_EVENT)
    .select(
        F.col("mve_gkey").alias("mve_gkey_load"),
        F.col("Unit_Nbr").alias("load_unit_nbr"),
        F.col("Carrier_Visit_Key").alias("load_carrier_visit_key"),
        F.col("From_Position_Name").alias("load_from_position"),
        F.col("from_stack").alias("load_from_stack"),
        F.col("from_section").alias("load_from_section"),
        F.col("from_bay").alias("load_from_bay"),
        F.col("from_tier_letter").alias("load_tier_letter"),
        F.col("t_put").alias("load_time"),
        F.to_date(F.col("t_put")).alias("load_date"),
        F.col("Goods_And_Ctr_Wt_Kg").cast("double").alias("load_weight_kg"),
        F.col("Freight_Kind_Id").alias("load_freight_kind"),
        F.col("Category_Id").alias("load_category_id"),
        F.col("pow").alias("load_pow"),
        F.col("`Unit_POD`").alias("load_pod"),
        F.col("`Carrier_Service`").alias("load_carrier_service"),
    )
)

shifts = (
    df_moves
    .filter(F.col("event_type").isin(SHIFT_EVENTS))
    .select(
        F.col("mve_gkey").alias("mve_gkey_shift"),
        F.col("Unit_Nbr").alias("shift_unit_nbr"),
        F.col("from_stack").alias("shift_from_stack"),
        F.col("t_put").alias("shift_time"),
        F.col("Goods_And_Ctr_Wt_Kg").cast("double").alias("shift_weight_kg"),
        F.col("`Unit_POD`").alias("shift_pod"),
        F.col("Carrier_Visit_Key").alias("shift_carrier_visit_key"),
        F.col("`Carrier_Service`").alias("shift_carrier_service"),
    )
)

def fail_if_invalid_move_keys(df, key_column, label):
    if df.filter(F.col(key_column).isNull()).limit(1).count():
        raise ValueError(f"{label} contains a null {key_column}")

    duplicates = (
        df.groupBy(key_column)
        .count()
        .filter(F.col("count") > 1)
        .limit(1)
    )

    if duplicates.count():
        raise ValueError(
            f"{label} contains duplicate {key_column} values"
        )


fail_if_invalid_move_keys(loads, "mve_gkey_load", "Loads")
fail_if_invalid_move_keys(shifts, "mve_gkey_shift", "Shifts")

print("Loads :", loads.count())
print("Shifts:", shifts.count())

# ============================================================
# CELL 6 — Rehandle matching with reason cascade
# ============================================================

REASON_DIFF_CARRIER     = "Different Outbound Carrier"
REASON_DIFF_POD         = "Same Outbound, Different POD"
REASON_DIFF_WEIGHT      = "Same Outbound & POD, Different Weight"
REASON_ALL_SAME         = "Unnecessary Shifting (All Same)"
REASON_UNDETERMINED     = "Undetermined"

WEIGHT_THRESHOLD_KG = 2000.0


def assign_rehandles(loads_df, shifts_df):
    """
    Rule:
      - Same parsed source stack.
      - Shift strictly before load.
      - Load no more than THRESHOLD_SECONDS after shift.
      - Assign a shift to the first qualifying later load.

    Reason cascade (evaluated on the shifted unit vs the loaded unit):
      1. Any of POD / carrier / weight is null on either side
                                        → Undetermined
      2. shift_carrier ≠ load_carrier   → Different Outbound Carrier
      3. shift_pod ≠ load_pod           → Same Outbound, Different POD
      4. |shift_weight − load_weight| > WEIGHT_THRESHOLD_KG
                                        → Same Outbound & POD, Different Weight
      5. otherwise                      → Unnecessary Shifting (All Same)

    Returns:
      per_load : one row per load — counts, reason breakdown, detail array.
      assigned : one row per shift-load pair — for audit.
    """

    load_keys = (
        loads_df
        .select(
            "mve_gkey_load",
            "load_from_stack",
            "load_time",
            "load_pod",
            "load_carrier_visit_key",
            "load_carrier_service",
            "load_weight_kg",
        )
        .filter(F.col("load_from_stack").isNotNull())
        .alias("l")
    )

    shift_keys = (
        shifts_df
        .select(
            "mve_gkey_shift",
            "shift_from_stack",
            "shift_time",
            "shift_pod",
            "shift_carrier_visit_key",
            "shift_carrier_service",
            "shift_weight_kg",
        )
        .filter(F.col("shift_from_stack").isNotNull())
        .alias("s")
    )

    join_condition = (
        (F.col("s.shift_from_stack") == F.col("l.load_from_stack"))
        & (F.col("s.shift_time") < F.col("l.load_time"))
        & (
            F.col("l.load_time")
            <= F.col("s.shift_time")
               + F.expr(f"INTERVAL {THRESHOLD_SECONDS} SECONDS")
        )
    )

    candidates = (
        shift_keys
        .join(load_keys, join_condition, "inner")
        .select(
            F.col("s.mve_gkey_shift"),
            F.col("s.shift_from_stack"),
            F.col("s.shift_time"),
            F.col("s.shift_pod"),
            F.col("s.shift_carrier_service"),
            F.col("s.shift_carrier_visit_key"),
            F.col("s.shift_weight_kg"),
            F.col("l.mve_gkey_load"),
            F.col("l.load_time"),
            F.col("l.load_pod"),
            F.col("l.load_carrier_service"),
            F.col("l.load_carrier_visit_key"),
            F.col("l.load_weight_kg"),
        )
    )

    first_subsequent_load = (
        Window
        .partitionBy("mve_gkey_shift")
        .orderBy(
            F.col("load_time").asc(),
            F.col("mve_gkey_load").asc(),
        )
    )

    # Assign each shift to its earliest qualifying load.
    assigned = (
        candidates
        .withColumn("_load_rank", F.row_number().over(first_subsequent_load))
        .filter(F.col("_load_rank") == 1)
        .drop("_load_rank")
    )

    # --- Reason cascade ---
    is_undetermined = (
        F.col("shift_pod").isNull()
        | F.col("load_pod").isNull()
        | F.col("shift_carrier_visit_key").isNull()
        | F.col("load_carrier_visit_key").isNull()
        | F.col("shift_weight_kg").isNull()
        | F.col("load_weight_kg").isNull()
    )

    assigned = assigned.withColumn(
        "rehandle_reason",
        F.when(is_undetermined, REASON_UNDETERMINED)
        .when(
            F.col("shift_carrier_visit_key") != F.col("load_carrier_visit_key"),
            REASON_DIFF_CARRIER,
        )
        .when(
            F.col("shift_pod") != F.col("load_pod"),
            REASON_DIFF_POD,
        )
        .when(
            F.abs(F.col("shift_weight_kg") - F.col("load_weight_kg"))
            > F.lit(WEIGHT_THRESHOLD_KG),
            REASON_DIFF_WEIGHT,
        )
        .otherwise(REASON_ALL_SAME),
    )

    # --- Aggregate to one row per load ---
    per_load = (
        assigned
        .groupBy("mve_gkey_load")
        .agg(
            F.count("*").alias("rehandle_count"),
            F.sort_array(
                F.collect_set("mve_gkey_shift")
            ).alias("rehandle_shift_ids"),
            F.min("shift_time").alias("first_rehandle_time"),
            F.max("shift_time").alias("last_rehandle_time"),

            # Per-reason counts
            F.sum(F.when(
                F.col("rehandle_reason") == REASON_DIFF_CARRIER, 1
            ).otherwise(0)).alias("cnt_diff_carrier"),

            F.sum(F.when(
                F.col("rehandle_reason") == REASON_DIFF_POD, 1
            ).otherwise(0)).alias("cnt_diff_pod"),

            F.sum(F.when(
                F.col("rehandle_reason") == REASON_DIFF_WEIGHT, 1
            ).otherwise(0)).alias("cnt_diff_weight"),

            F.sum(F.when(
                F.col("rehandle_reason") == REASON_ALL_SAME, 1
            ).otherwise(0)).alias("cnt_all_same"),

            F.sum(F.when(
                F.col("rehandle_reason") == REASON_UNDETERMINED, 1
            ).otherwise(0)).alias("cnt_undetermined"),

            # Detail array — one struct per rehandle, for drill-down
            F.collect_list(
                F.struct(
                    F.col("mve_gkey_shift"),
                    F.col("rehandle_reason"),
                    F.col("shift_pod"),
                    F.col("shift_carrier_visit_key"),
                    F.col("shift_carrier_service"),
                    F.col("shift_weight_kg"),
                )
            ).alias("rehandle_details"),
        )
    )

    return per_load, assigned

# ============================================================
# CELL 7 — Matching test and production calculation
# ============================================================

from datetime import datetime

# --- Test data ---
# Load 101: 2 rehandles (shifts 201 + 202) — different carrier, different POD
# Load 102: 1 rehandle  (shift 203)         — all same → unnecessary
# Load 103: 0 rehandles (different stack)

test_loads = spark.createDataFrame(
    [
        (101, "169A-03", datetime(2026, 1, 1, 10, 10), "SGSIN", "CVK-A", "SVC-A", 22000.0),
        (102, "169A-03", datetime(2026, 1, 1, 10, 40), "SGSIN", "CVK-A", "SVC-A", 22000.0),
        (103, "785B-06", datetime(2026, 1, 1, 10, 10), "SGSIN", "CVK-A", "SVC-A", 22000.0),
    ],
    "mve_gkey_load long, load_from_stack string, load_time timestamp,"
    "load_pod string, load_carrier_visit_key string, load_carrier_service string, load_weight_kg double",
)

test_shifts = spark.createDataFrame(
    [
        # 201 → load 101: different carrier_visit_key
        (201, "169A-03", datetime(2026, 1, 1, 9, 50),  "SGSIN", "CVK-B", "SVC-B", 22000.0),
        # 202 → load 101: same carrier_visit_key, different POD
        (202, "169A-03", datetime(2026, 1, 1, 10, 5),  "CNSHA", "CVK-A", "SVC-A", 22000.0),
        # 203 → load 102: all same
        (203, "169A-03", datetime(2026, 1, 1, 10, 30), "SGSIN", "CVK-A", "SVC-A", 22000.0),
    ],
    "mve_gkey_shift long, shift_from_stack string, shift_time timestamp,"
    "shift_pod string, shift_carrier_visit_key string, shift_carrier_service string, shift_weight_kg double",
)

test_per_load, test_assigned = assign_rehandles(test_loads, test_shifts)

# Verify counts
test_result = (
    test_loads
    .join(test_per_load, "mve_gkey_load", "left")
    .select(
        "mve_gkey_load",
        F.coalesce(F.col("rehandle_count"), F.lit(0)).alias("rehandle_count"),
    )
)

actual_counts = {
    row["mve_gkey_load"]: row["rehandle_count"]
    for row in test_result.collect()
}

assert actual_counts == {101: 2, 102: 1, 103: 0}, (
    f"Count test failed: {actual_counts}"
)

# Verify reasons
actual_reasons = {
    row["mve_gkey_shift"]: row["rehandle_reason"]
    for row in test_assigned.select(
        "mve_gkey_shift", "rehandle_reason"
    ).collect()
}

expected_reasons = {
    201: REASON_DIFF_CARRIER,
    202: REASON_DIFF_POD,
    203: REASON_ALL_SAME,
}

assert actual_reasons == expected_reasons, (
    f"Reason test failed: {actual_reasons}"
)

print("Matching test passed :", actual_counts)
print("Reason test passed   :", actual_reasons)

# --- Production run ---
per_load, assigned_shifts = assign_rehandles(loads, shifts)

df_results = (
    loads
    .join(per_load, "mve_gkey_load", "left")
    .withColumn(
        "rehandle_count",
        F.coalesce(F.col("rehandle_count"), F.lit(0).cast("long")),
    )
    .withColumn("has_rehandle",           F.col("rehandle_count") > 0)
    .withColumn("has_unnecessary_shift",  F.col("cnt_all_same") > 0)
    # Loads with zero rehandles get 0 for all reason counters
    .withColumn("cnt_diff_carrier",  F.coalesce(F.col("cnt_diff_carrier"),  F.lit(0)))
    .withColumn("cnt_diff_pod",      F.coalesce(F.col("cnt_diff_pod"),      F.lit(0)))
    .withColumn("cnt_diff_weight",   F.coalesce(F.col("cnt_diff_weight"),   F.lit(0)))
    .withColumn("cnt_all_same",      F.coalesce(F.col("cnt_all_same"),      F.lit(0)))
    .withColumn("cnt_undetermined",  F.coalesce(F.col("cnt_undetermined"),  F.lit(0)))
)

# ============================================================
# CELL 8 — Quality checks and summary
# ============================================================

total_loads  = loads.count()
total_shifts = shifts.count()

unparsed_loads  = loads.filter(F.col("load_from_stack").isNull()).count()
unparsed_shifts = shifts.filter(F.col("shift_from_stack").isNull()).count()

assigned_count = assigned_shifts.count()
output_count   = df_results.count()

summary = df_results.agg(
    F.sum("rehandle_count").alias("total_rehandles"),
    F.sum(F.when(F.col("has_rehandle"), 1).otherwise(0)).alias("loads_with_rehandles"),
    F.sum("cnt_diff_carrier").alias("total_diff_carrier"),
    F.sum("cnt_diff_pod").alias("total_diff_pod"),
    F.sum("cnt_diff_weight").alias("total_diff_weight"),
    F.sum("cnt_all_same").alias("total_all_same"),
    F.sum("cnt_undetermined").alias("total_undetermined"),
).first()

assert output_count == total_loads, (
    f"Output is not one row per load: {output_count} rows for {total_loads} loads"
)
assert (summary["total_rehandles"] or 0) == assigned_count, (
    "Aggregated rehandle count differs from assigned shifts"
)

print("Total loads                 :", total_loads)
print("Total shifts                :", total_shifts)
print("Unparsed load positions     :", unparsed_loads)
print("Unparsed shift positions    :", unparsed_shifts)
print("Loads with rehandles        :", summary["loads_with_rehandles"])
print("Total rehandles             :", summary["total_rehandles"])
print(f"  ↳ {REASON_DIFF_CARRIER:<40}:", summary["total_diff_carrier"])
print(f"  ↳ {REASON_DIFF_POD:<40}:", summary["total_diff_pod"])
print(f"  ↳ {REASON_DIFF_WEIGHT:<40}:", summary["total_diff_weight"])
print(f"  ↳ {REASON_ALL_SAME:<40}:", summary["total_all_same"])
print(f"  ↳ {REASON_UNDETERMINED:<40}:", summary["total_undetermined"])
print("Output rows                 :", output_count)

print("\nSample loads with rehandles:")
df_results.filter(F.col("rehandle_count") > 0).select(
    "mve_gkey_load",
    "load_unit_nbr",
    "load_from_stack",
    "load_time",
    "rehandle_count",
    "cnt_diff_carrier",
    "cnt_diff_pod",
    "cnt_diff_weight",
    "cnt_all_same",
    "cnt_undetermined",
    "has_unnecessary_shift",
    "rehandle_details",
).show(20, truncate=False)

print("\nSample unparsed MCT source positions:")
df_moves.filter(F.col("from_stack").isNull()).groupBy(
    "From_Position_Name"
).count().orderBy(F.desc("count")).show(20, truncate=False)

# ============================================================
# CELL 9 — Write DGT output and register table
# ============================================================

spark.sql("CREATE DATABASE IF NOT EXISTS rehandles_db")

# Check an existing registration BEFORE overwriting data.
if spark.catalog.tableExists(TABLE_NAME):
    registered_location = (
        spark.sql(f"DESCRIBE DETAIL {TABLE_NAME}")
        .select("location")
        .first()["location"]
    )

    if registered_location.rstrip("/") != OUTPUT_DELTA.rstrip("/"):
        raise ValueError(
            f"{TABLE_NAME} already points to "
            f"{registered_location}, not {OUTPUT_DELTA}. "
            "Resolve the table location before writing."
        )

(
    df_results.write
    .format("delta")
    .mode("overwrite")
    .option("overwriteSchema", "true")
    .save(OUTPUT_DELTA)
)

spark.sql(f"""
    CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS {TABLE_NAME}
    USING DELTA
    LOCATION '{OUTPUT_DELTA}'
""")

print("Written to :", OUTPUT_DELTA)
print("Registered :", TABLE_NAME)

# ============================================================
# CELL 10 — Verify saved output
# ============================================================

df_check = spark.read.format("delta").load(OUTPUT_DELTA)

saved_rows = df_check.count()
assert saved_rows == total_loads, (
    f"Saved {saved_rows} rows; expected {total_loads}"
)

saved_summary = df_check.agg(
    F.sum("rehandle_count").alias("total_rehandles")
).first()

assert (saved_summary["total_rehandles"] or 0) == total_rehandles

print("Saved rows      :", saved_rows)
print("Saved rehandles:", saved_summary["total_rehandles"] or 0)

df_check.select(
    "mve_gkey_load",
    "load_unit_nbr",
    "load_from_stack",
    "load_time",
    "rehandle_count",
    "rehandle_shift_ids",
    "has_rehandle",
).orderBy(
    F.desc("rehandle_count"),
    F.asc("load_time"),
